narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Two copies of eigh and four copies of b. That is two eigh times four b.
<bookmark mark='add'/>Two eigh means eigh plus eigh, which is adding, not multiplying.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The copies here are multiplied, so the count must go up high as an exponent.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Count the copies of each factor, and write the count as its exponent.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Write p times p times p times q times q in short. Then write seventy two as powers of primes.
